firstPlayerRule: Give the first-player marker to the person who has had the most regrettable day.
clarifications: The first day is spent at sea. On subsequent days, pass the first-player marker clockwise; declarations and actions proceed clockwise from the marker holder.
internalEvidence: Inspected publisher-authored English rulebook text preserved by Gamers HQ. Player Setup on PDF page 4 (printed page 6) assigns the first-player marker by most regrettable day; Day Phases on page 5 (printed page 8) passes it clockwise at the start of subsequent days and uses clockwise order for declarations and actions.
